continuity_notes: Rain continues from Episode 1; Maya's hair is still wet in Scene 1.

raw_text:
EPISODE NUMBER: 2
EPISODE LOGLINE: Savitri brings Maya into the Malhotra mansion, but Rhea is determined to prove the "lost heiress" is a fraud before the will is read.
CONTINUITY NOTES:
- Rain continues from Episode 1; Maya's hair is still wet in Scene 1.
- Savitri carries a walking cane with a silver lion head.
- The DNA envelope is red-sealed.

SCENE 1: INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - GRAND HALL - NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:00:00 | SCENE END: 00:00:58
CAMERA: Low angle on the towering doors as they swing open.
[00:00:00 - 00:00:05] ACTION: Savitri enters, cane striking marble. Maya follows, soaked, in her waitress uniform.
[00:00:05 - 00:00:10] ACTION: The family is gathered: Rhea, Vikram, and Rhea's mother, NANDINI.
[00:00:10 - 00:00:15] NANDINI: Maa, you brought a stray in from the rain? At this hour?
[00:00:15 - 00:00:21] SAVITRI: Watch your tongue, Nandini. This girl is Meera's daughter. My granddaughter.
[00:00:21 - 00:00:25] ACTION: Silence. A glass slips from Nandini's fingers.
[00:00:25 - 00:00:30] RHEA: That's absurd. Meera's baby died with her. Everyone knows that.
[00:00:30 - 00:00:35] MAYA: Then someone should have told me. I've been alive this whole time.
[00:00:35 - 00:00:40] ACTION: Vikram stares at the floor, jaw clenched, his gloved hand trembling.
[00:00:40 - 00:00:46] SAVITRI: Tomorrow we take a DNA test. Until then, she sleeps in Meera's room.
[00:00:46 - 00:00:52] RHEA: (through a smile) Of course, Dadi. Whatever makes you happy.
[00:00:52 - 00:00:58] ACTION: As Savitri turns away, Rhea's smile drops. She locks eyes with her mother.

SCENE 2: INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - MEERA'S ROOM - NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:00:58 | SCENE END: 00:01:50
CAMERA: Dust in moonlight. Slow pan across covered furniture.
[00:00:58 - 00:01:03] ACTION: Maya pulls a sheet off a vanity mirror. A photo is tucked into the frame.
[00:01:03 - 00:01:08] ACTION: The photo shows her mother, pregnant, standing beside a young NANDINI.
[00:01:08 - 00:01:12] MAYA: You knew her. You knew me.
[00:01:12 - 00:01:17] ACTION: A knock. Vikram slips inside and closes the door behind him.
[00:01:17 - 00:01:22] VIKRAM: You need to leave this house tonight. Before the test.
[00:01:22 - 00:01:27] MAYA: So you can finish what the fire started?
[00:01:27 - 00:01:33] VIKRAM: I didn't lock that door, Maya. Someone locked it from the outside. Someone in this family.
[00:01:33 - 00:01:38] ACTION: Maya hesitates. For the first time, doubt flickers across her face.
[00:01:38 - 00:01:44] MAYA: Then why didn't you come back for me?
[00:01:44 - 00:01:50] VIKRAM: Because they told me you were dead. And they showed me a body.

SCENE 3: INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - NANDINI'S STUDY - NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:01:50 | SCENE END: 00:02:38
CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder through a half-open door.
[00:01:50 - 00:01:55] ACTION: Nandini paces. Rhea sits on the desk, scrolling her phone.
[00:01:55 - 00:02:01] RHEA: Relax, Mumma. A DNA test takes three days. We have time.
[00:02:01 - 00:02:07] NANDINI: You don't understand. If she is Meera's girl, the will gives her everything. Everything.
[00:02:07 - 00:02:12] RHEA: Then we make sure the results say she isn't.
[00:02:12 - 00:02:17] ACTION: Rhea opens a drawer and lifts out a red-sealed envelope.
[00:02:17 - 00:02:22] NANDINI: Where did you get that?
[00:02:22 - 00:02:28] RHEA: The lab director owes me a favour. These results were printed an hour ago.
[00:02:28 - 00:02:33] ACTION: Outside the door, a shadow shifts. Someone has been listening.
[00:02:33 - 00:02:38] ACTION: The floorboard creaks. Rhea's head snaps toward the door.
